fileNodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts

fileNodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines automatic debuff application logic based on perk conditions, including HP threshold checks and debuff generation for various game mechanics.

fileNodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines base damage constants for various perk abilities and special attacks in the game.

fileNodes.name: storage.ts

fileNodes.name: dmgTypes.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines damage type badge configurations and display constants for the damage analyzer UI.

fileNodes.name: store.ts
fileNodes.summary: Svelte store module managing build state persistence, enchantment manipulation, guild/race configuration, and armor/ring slot reordering. Exports reactive stores and updater functions that form the central state management layer for the Voxel Blade damage calculator.

Fallow (dead-code analyzer) configuration. Defines entry points (src/index.*, src/main.*), sets duplicate minimum occurrences to 3, enables unused-dependencies warnings, and suppresses exports from several Svelte components (AccessorySelectModal, GuildModal, WeaponPartModal, RaceModal, DidYouMean, ModalSearchHeader, TagFilter) and constants file.

Agent context document for the voxlblade-builder project. Describes the project as a web-based damage calculator for Roblox game 'Voxel Blade'. Documents the tech stack (Svelte 5, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, pnpm), project structure, development workflow commands, AI agent interaction guidelines, file operations, testing procedures, and security policies.

Project README based on Svelte + TS + Vite template. Covers recommended IDE setup (VS Code + Svelte extension), explains why this uses plain Vite over SvelteKit, discusses TypeScript configuration choices (global.d.ts vs compilerOptions.types, allowJs, checkJs), and notes on HMR state preservation.

Fallow v2.102.0 dead-code analysis report. Found 28 issues: 1 unused file (svelte.config.js), 23 unused exports across data modules (Boost.ts, Runebasedmg.ts, defensivePerks.ts, draconicColorEffects.ts, raceEffects.ts, weaponConditionalBoosts.ts, etc.), 2 unused types, and 2 duplicate exports. Entry points: 4 total (1 default index, 3 plugin).

Fallow v2.102.0 security analysis report. Identifies low-severity tainted-sink findings: dangerous-html (CWE-79) via template.innerHTML in DidYouMean.svelte:22, SuggestDrop.svelte:21, App.svelte:1319; dynamic-regex (CWE-1333) via RegExp in App.svelte:253. All findings are reachable from entry but not from untrusted sources, non-cross-boundary.

fileNodes.name: ui-upgrade
fileNodes.summary: Multi-phase UI upgrade plan for the voxlblade app — covers modal extraction, toast system, CSS consolidation, responsive improvements, accessibility, and build comparison.

fileNodes.name: .understandignore
fileNodes.summary: Configuration file listing file patterns to exclude from the understand-anything analysis tool (intermediate artifacts, test files, etc.).

fileNodes.name: analyze-mounticon
fileNodes.summary: One-off debug script that reads MountIcon.svelte and extracts/displays its SVG path data length and content.

fileNodes.name: decode_full
fileNodes.summary: Standalone build decoder/debugging tool that reconstructs full character stats from equipment, enchantments, infusions, shrine, and perks using the same formulas as the main engine.

fileNodes.name: ONBOARDING
fileNodes.summary: Comprehensive onboarding guide documenting project architecture across 9 layers (config, source root, data, library, constants, engine, modals, statistics, stores), key concepts, guided tour, and complexity hotspots.

fileNodes.name: app.css
fileNodes.summary: Global CSS file defining all design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, shadows, z-index, transitions, durations), base resets, scrollbar styling, and utility classes for weapon art boxes and wild bolt UI.

fileNodes.name: App.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Main application component that orchestrates the Voxel Blade damage calculator, managing build state, UI layout, and component composition.

fileNodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Component for calculating and displaying base damage values from weapon stats and modifiers.

fileNodes.name: BuffList.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Component for displaying and managing active buffs and debuffs in the damage calculator.

fileNodes.name: BuildSaves
fileNodes.summary: Build save/load management component (~1100 lines) providing localStorage-based save slots with rename, drag-to-reorder, export/import (compressed base64), duplicate detection, fuzzy search across saved builds, and touch/mouse drag support.

fileNodes.name: CdrStepsCalc
fileNodes.summary: Visual cooldown reduction step calculator showing sequential CDR application (multiplicative or divisive) with floor rounding and minimum cooldown cap.

fileNodes.name: CritIcon
fileNodes.summary: Simple SVG icon component rendering a critical hit symbol with a red-to-orange gradient.

fileNodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Component for analyzing and displaying detailed damage breakdowns by type, including defense calculations and damage multipliers.

fileNodes.name: draconicRunes
fileNodes.summary: Draconic rune and dragon infusion bonus calculation functions — applies color-based damage type bonuses from draconic rune stacks and dragon infusion buff potency.

fileNodes.name: selfDamagePerks
fileNodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk definitions (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier) and a calculator function that computes self-damage with DR scaling, multi-target harmonic falloff, and per-type defense multipliers.

fileNodes.name: stanceOverlays
fileNodes.summary: Resolves weapon stance overlays (Blaster Ring, Locked And Loaded, Cosmic Ray, Mine) based on context like fist/weapon type, blaster count, and weapon perks.

fileNodes.name: DidYouMean
fileNodes.summary: Search suggestion component displaying 'Did you mean?' chips when no exact search results are found, with highlighted text matching and perk-type differentiation.

fileNodes.name: DmgTotalTooltip
fileNodes.summary: Damage total tooltip component showing a pie chart of damage type distribution with per-type breakdowns, percentages, and badge labels for a computed hit.

fileNodes.name: DraconicAbilityStats
fileNodes.summary: Display component for draconic ability stats: damage type, scaling, poise damage, and optional holy/water healing values.

fileNodes.name: EmotionalTracker
fileNodes.summary: Interactive slider component for selecting emotional state (debuff/both/buff) with color-coded buttons, segmented track visualization, and build store integration.

fileNodes.name: Highlight
fileNodes.summary: Simple text highlighting component that wraps matching substrings with a highlight mark element.

fileNodes.name: LevelBar
fileNodes.summary: Interactive level and HP bar component with inline level editing, draggable HP fill, shield overlay, damage threshold line, and protection display.

fileNodes.name: AppHeader
fileNodes.summary: Application header component with title, animated tab switcher (Overview/Analyze), tab bubble transition, keyboard tab-switching shortcut, and integrated BuildSaves panel.

fileNodes.name: boosts.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines boost constants and multipliers for various damage calculation mechanics.

fileNodes.name: cdr
fileNodes.summary: Cooldown reduction constant definitions for CDR-related perks (Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Acceleration, Whirlwind, etc.).

fileNodes.name: uiConstants.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines UI color constants and source labels for the damage analyzer display components.

fileNodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
fileNodes.summary: Calculates per-damage-type damage multipliers and heal multipliers from active buffs and perks (e.g., Glyph Conduit for magic, Rage for physical/magic/water, Photosynthesis for holy/earth in sunlight). Aggregates into a dmgMultByType map.

fileNodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
fileNodes.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, both-parts) are met by the current build, and produces human-readable lists of unmet requirements.

fileNodes.name: weaponArts.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines the WeaponArt and WeaponArtRequirement interfaces and the WEAPON_ARTS data array containing all weapon art definitions with their names, descriptions, cooldowns, damage, scaling, hits, and requirements.

fileNodes.name: damage-types.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

fileNodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
fileNodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

fileNodes.name: _utils.ts
fileNodes.summary: Minimal utility module exporting round2 and round4 functions for numeric rounding with epsilon correction, used throughout the engine layer.

fileNodes.name: build.ts
fileNodes.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

fileNodes.name: data.ts
fileNodes.summary: Barrel re-export module that re-exports all symbols from character, equipment, and weapon data sub-modules, providing a single import point for game data accessors.

fileNodes.name: enchant.ts
fileNodes.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

fileNodes.name: format.ts
fileNodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

fileNodes.name: shrine.ts
fileNodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

fileNodes.name: weapon.ts
fileNodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

fileNodes.name: constants.ts
fileNodes.summary: Barrel re-export file for all game constants. Re-exports all sub-modules from the constants directory providing a single import point.

fileNodes.name: buffs.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines buff-related constants including buff potency calculations, duration modifiers, and stacking rules.

fileNodes.name: DoTDamage.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines damage-over-time (DoT) calculation constants and functions for bleed, poison, and fire DoT effects.

fileNodes.name: draconicColorEffects.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines draconic color-based effects including elemental damage bonuses and status effects tied to draconic color selection.

fileNodes.name: types.ts
fileNodes.summary: Core TypeScript type definitions for the damage calculator. Defines interfaces for BuildState, equipment stats, perks, enchantments, damage types, and all game data structures.

fileNodes.name: engine.ts
fileNodes.summary: Barrel re-export file for the engine module. Re-exports all engine sub-modules: data, shrine, enchant, weapon, build, and format.
